summary: Short regression retest of the iteration_4 fixes (frontend only). Every requested item passed. The only remaining issue is minor: 2 blog posts still describe dragging cards.

issues: src/data/blog.js line 19 ('drag them to set the correct order') and line 115 ('Drag the image cards to set the page order') still describe drag-and-drop, but the tools use up/down arrows. The tool pages themselves (tools.js) are correct.

action_items: Update the steps in src/data/blog.js at lines 19 and 115 to say 'use the up/down arrows' (optional, minor)
critical_code_review_comments: The ToolsDropdown click handler uses e.detail===0 to tell keyboard from mouse. It works, but a mouse click never closes the menu (it closes on mouseleave or an outside click). That is acceptable for hover menus.
verified: Dropdown: hover opens it; hover+click keeps it open (aria-expanded=true, menu visible); an outside click closes it; Enter opens it; Escape closes it; pressing Enter twice toggles it off
No console errors and no /api/auth calls on /, /merge-pdf, /blog, /faq
Admin login works, then /admin/dashboard loads and still loads after a reload (/auth/me is only called on /admin routes)
yarn build passes; 404.html and app.html have noindex; index.html has index,follow; firebase.json rewrites only /admin/** to /app.html

Static build served on localhost:5077 with clean URLs: an unknown URL returns 404 with the NotFound page; 0 requests to the preview host; all /api calls are same-origin; merge (merged.pdf, %PDF-) and jpg-to-pdf (images.pdf, %PDF-) work; the contact form shows 'We could not send your message right now. Please email us at support@mycrushpdf.com.'
The jpg-to-pdf and merge how-to steps mention the up and down arrows; no 'Drag the cards' text on the tool page
Preview: merging 2 PDFs downloads merged.pdf; uploading 21 images shows 'You can upload a maximum of 20 images at a time.'
